burst: the swap beam (22.2%) and the 11.9% rider are both gated by the kit on "when Hero Vision is at max stacks", and the model assumes that gate is OPEN for the whole 10s window. OWNER RULING 2026-08-12 fixes the mechanism: Hero Vision stacks come ONLY from Full Charge attacks, and her burst weapon does not charge — so she gains ZERO stacks during the window and enters it with whatever she built. She can still LOSE them: each stack lasts 15s and cannot be refreshed while swapped. With her cadence (60f charge + 22f bolt recovery = 1.37s/shot) the 5 stacks she holds at cast were granted over the preceding ~6.8s, so the oldest expires ~8s into the window and the gate shuts for roughly its last ~2s — an over-credit of about a fifth of the window, before counting any pre-burst reload gap (ammo 6 / 161f), which pushes the lapse earlier. ⚑ NOT ENACTED: the gate is INEXPRESSIBLE — it reads the COUNT of a stacked, individually-expiring self buff, and the engine's gates are fbGate / swapGate / requiresCore / requiresShielded / bossElementGate / ownBurstGate / resourceGate / teamHas / everyN, of which only resourceGate counts anything and a resource never expires. Logged as a carrier against that primitive gap rather than built for one unit.
